race.comment: SURPRISE HONEY (10) ended a run of largely disappointing performances with a dominant win a fortnight ago over 1200m at Eagle Farm, leaving SER JOH in her wake. Meets him 2kgs worse for a 2.2 length margin. Has never raced beyond 1200m but she showed no sign of stopping last start so she should run it out. SER JOH (6) is the danger as he has more improvement to come than the mare at just his third run of the prep. Placed at three of four runs over today's journey and draws a lot closer than last time. Should make things very interesting. BLAZING HARRY (7) has chased home the in-form Braveheart at his last couple, most recently last Saturday over 1200m here. Big chance to go one better over a bit more ground this time. NAILS MURPHY (3) is back from an 18-week spell. Might need the run and a longer trip but while fresh he could surprise. ACAPPELLA SUN (12) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and has won two from three here at this distance.
